title.zh: 第 1 步 · 移項，令右邊是 0
title.en: Step 1 · Move terms to one side

steps.zh: 兩邊有相同的括號 $(x-3t)$，先移項令右邊是 $0$，不可以直接約走。
steps.en: Bring all terms to the left.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽公因式，注意變號
title.en: Step 2 · Factor out, mind the signs

steps.zh: 抽出公因式 $(x-3t)$ 後，中括號內為 $(x-2t)-(6t-x)$。注意負號分配律：$-(6t-x)=-6t+x$。合併同類項得 $(x-3t)(2x-8t)=0$。
steps.en: After factoring out $(x-3t)$, the expression inside the square brackets is $(x-2t)-(6t-x)$. Mind the minus sign: $-(6t-x)=-6t+x$. Collecting like terms yields $(x-3t)(2x-8t)=0$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 各自等於 0
title.en: Step 3 · Set each bracket to 0

steps.zh: 得出 $x=3t$ 或 $x=4t$，答案選 D。
steps.en: x = 3t or x = 4t. Answer: D.

traps.zh: $x=3t$ 只寫了其中一個根（來自 $(x-3t)$），漏了另一邊解出的 $x=4t$。
traps.en: Only one of the two roots was given.

traps.zh: $x=6t$ 是誤把 $6t-x$ 當成一個因式並令它等於 $0$。真正的因式是 $(x-3t)$ 與 $(x-2t)$，$6t-x$ 不是因式（它是等號右邊的其中一個括號）。
traps.en: The right-hand bracket is not a factor.

tip.zh: 相減時括號內每一項都要變號：$-(6t-x)=-6t+x$。這一步錯了，之後的答案一定錯。
tip.en: When both sides share the same bracket, move everything to one side and factor it out — never cancel it.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法
name.en: Substitution check

alt.en: Put $t=2$ (avoid $0$ and $1$): the equation becomes $(x-4)(x-6)=(12-x)(x-6)$, giving $x=6$ or $8$. Substituting $t=2$ into the options, only D gives $x=6$ or $8$.

name.zh: 另解：分兩種情況（先取公因式為 0，再約走）
name.en: Method 2: two cases (take the factor = 0 first, then cancel)

alt.zh:
分兩種情況：
① 先取共同括號 $(x-3t)=0$ —— 兩邊都變成 $0$，所以 $x=3t$ 是一個根；
② 其餘情況 $x-3t\ne 0$，才可以放心兩邊約走 $(x-3t)$：$x-2t=6t-x\ \Rightarrow\ 2x=8t\ \Rightarrow\ x=4t$。
兩個根齊全：$x=3t$ 或 $x=4t$，答案 D。
alt.en:
Two cases:
(1) take the shared bracket $(x-3t)=0$ — both sides become $0$, so $x=3t$ is a root;
(2) otherwise $x-3t\ne 0$, so you may safely cancel $(x-3t)$: $x-2t=6t-x\ \Rightarrow\ 2x=8t\ \Rightarrow\ x=4t$.
Both roots: $x=3t$ or $x=4t$, answer D.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 移項，令右邊是 0
title.en: Step 1 · Move terms to one side

steps.zh: 兩邊有相同的括號 $(x+4h)$，先把所有項移到左邊。
steps.en: Bring all terms to the left.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽公因式 $(x+4h)$
title.en: Step 2 · Factor out (x + 4h)

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 各自等於 0
title.en: Step 3 · Set each bracket to 0

steps.zh: 得出 $x=-4h$ 或 $x=h$，答案選 C。
steps.en: x = -4h or x = h. Answer: C.

traps.zh: $x=-4h$ 只寫了其中一個根（來自 $(x+4h)$），漏了另一邊解出的 $x=h$。
traps.en: Only one of the two roots was given.

traps.zh: $x=-6h$ 或 $x=8h$ 是把 $(x+6h)$ 與 $(8h-x)$ 各令等於 $0$ —— 這兩個括號分別在等號兩邊，不是同一邊的因式，這樣做等於沒有移項。
traps.en: The two brackets sit on opposite sides of the equation.

tip.zh: 與前一題同一招式：相同括號不可以約，要走「移項 → 抽公因式 → 各自等於 0」三步。
tip.en: Same routine: move everything to one side, factor out the common bracket, then set each factor to zero.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法
name.en: Substitution check

alt.en: Put $h=1$: the equation becomes $(x+6)(x+4)=(8-x)(x+4)$, giving $x=-4$ or $1$. Substituting $h=1$ into the options, only C gives $x=-4$ or $1$.

name.zh: 另解：分兩種情況（先取公因式為 0，再約走）
name.en: Method 2: two cases (take the factor = 0 first, then cancel)

alt.zh:
分兩種情況：
① 先取共同括號 $(x+4h)=0$ —— 兩邊都變成 $0$，所以 $x=-4h$ 是一個根；
② 其餘情況 $x+4h\ne 0$，才可以放心兩邊約走 $(x+4h)$：$x+6h=8h-x\ \Rightarrow\ 2x=2h\ \Rightarrow\ x=h$。
兩個根齊全：$x=-4h$ 或 $x=h$，答案 C。
alt.en:
Two cases:
(1) take the shared bracket $(x+4h)=0$ — both sides become $0$, so $x=-4h$ is a root;
(2) otherwise $x+4h\ne 0$, so you may safely cancel $(x+4h)$: $x+6h=8h-x\ \Rightarrow\ 2x=2h\ \Rightarrow\ x=h$.
Both roots: $x=-4h$ or $x=h$, answer C.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 由「$\alpha$ 是方程的根」寫出關係式
title.en: Step 1 · Use the fact that α is a root

steps.zh: 「$\alpha$ 是方程 $x^{2}-4x-2=0$ 的根」意思是把 $x$ 換成 $\alpha$ 之後等式成立：$\alpha^{2}-4\alpha-2=0$。移項得到 $\alpha^{2}=4\alpha+2$，用它可以把 $\alpha^{2}$ 降到一次。
steps.en: Substituting x = α gives α² = 4α + 2.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 把 $\alpha^{2}$ 整塊替換（記得加括號）
title.en: Step 2 · Replace α² as a whole

steps.zh: 把 $\alpha^{2}$ 換成 $(4\alpha+2)$。前面是 $-2$，所以一定要加括號，否則只會乘到第一項。

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 展開化簡
title.en: Step 3 · Expand and simplify

steps.zh: 展開 $=3+8\alpha-8\alpha-4$。$8\alpha$ 與 $-8\alpha$ 互相抵消，剩下 $3-4=-1$，答案選 B。
steps.en: Expanding gives $3+8\alpha-8\alpha-4$. The terms $8\alpha$ and $-8\alpha$ cancel out, leaving $3-4=-1$. The answer is B.

traps.zh: $7$ 是移項時把 $\alpha^{2}=4\alpha+2$ 寫成 $\alpha^{2}=4\alpha-2$（負號錯），得出 $3+8\alpha-8\alpha+4=7$。
traps.en: Sign slip when rearranging.

traps.zh: $9$ 是把 $\alpha=1$ 硬代入求出的值 —— $1$ 不是這個方程的根，所以不可以用。
traps.en: Substituted a number that is not a root.

tip.zh: 看到「$\alpha$ 是方程的根」就想「降次」：把 $\alpha^{2}$ 換成一次式，答案裡的 $\alpha$ 通常會自動抵消。
tip.en: For any “given a root” question, write the equation equal to 0 first, then build the target expression as a multiple of it.

name.zh: 計算機保底：求根後 Ans 鍵秒殺法
name.en: Calculator safety net: Root finding and Ans key

alt.zh: 考評局准用計算機直出答案：使用 Casio fx-50FH II 按【FMLA】【01】（或 fx-3650P II 執行二次方程程式 Prog 1），輸入 $a=1, b=-4, c=-2$。按【EXE】求出正根 $x \approx 4.449$。毋須抄寫小數，直接按鍵輸入 $3+8\text{Ans}-2\text{Ans}^{2}$ 並按【EXE】，螢幕即刻顯示 $-1$！直接鎖定選項 B。
alt.en: Direct calculator shortcut: On Casio fx-50FH II press [FMLA] [01] (or run Prog 1 on fx-3650P II), enter $a=1, b=-4, c=-2$. Press [EXE] to get root $x \approx 4.449$. Do not copy down decimals; directly type $3+8\text{Ans}-2\text{Ans}^{2}$ and press [EXE]. The screen displays $-1$, confirming option B immediately.

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 相等實根 ⇒ $\Delta=0$
title.en: Step 1 · Equal roots means Δ = 0

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 十字相乘分解
title.en: Step 2 · Factorize

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 讀出兩個 $k$
title.en: Step 3 · Solve for k

steps.zh: 所以 $k=-6$ 或 $k=18$，答案選 C。
steps.en: k = -6 or k = 18. Answer: C.

traps.zh: $-3$ 是判別式只算了 $4(3)(9)=108$（把 $c$ 當成 $9$、漏了 $k$），$\Delta$ 已經算錯，之後再解方程當然得不到正確答案。
traps.en: Wrong c in the discriminant.
Wrong factorisation; check the middle term.

tip.zh: 分解完一定要心算展開核對中間項。$c$ 代入時要整塊 $(k+9)$ 代入，不可以只拿 $9$。
tip.en: Equal roots means $\Delta=0$. Write the equation in standard form before substituting the discriminant.

name.zh: 卷二保底：逐個選項代 $\Delta=0$
name.en: Substitution check: test each option in $\Delta=0$

alt.en: Equal roots means $\Delta=0$: $(-k)^{2}-4(3)(k+9)=0$. Test the options: A ($k=-3$) gives $9-4(3)(6)\neq 0$ ✗, while C ($k=-6$) gives $36-4(3)(3)=0$ ✓ — only C works.

eph-en01-m3.source: WS05 課堂題 · [HKDSE Sample Paper 2 Q6]

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 搬去一邊：不要兩邊約走 $(x-b)$
title.en: Step 1 · Move everything to one side: never cancel $(x-b)$

steps.zh: 方程兩邊都有 $(x-b)$。約走它就等於假設 $x\ne b$，會白白失掉 $x=b$ 這個根。正確做法是把右邊那一份 $(x-b)$ 整塊搬去左邊。
steps.en: Both sides contain $(x-b)$. Cancelling it assumes $x\neq b$ and throws away the root $x=b$. Move the whole $(x-b)$ across instead.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽走 $(x-b)$：它剩下的是 1，不是 0
title.en: Step 2 · Factor out $(x-b)$: the leftover is 1, not 0

steps.zh: 搬過來的那一項是 $-1\times(x-b)$，所以抽走共同括號 $(x-b)$ 之後，它剩下的是 $1$。把這個 $1$ 寫清楚就不會出錯：$(x-b-8)-1$。
steps.en: The term moved across is $-1\times(x-b)$, so after factoring out $(x-b)$ it leaves 1 behind: $(x-b-8)-1$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 最常見的錯法：把 $(x-b)$ 當成 0（✗）對照正確的 1（✓）
title.en: Step 3 · The classic mistake: treating $(x-b)$ as 0 (✗) versus the correct 1 (✓)

steps.zh: ✗ 很多同學把 $(x-b)$「約簡為 $0$」：寫成 $(x-b-8)-0$，於是得到 $x=b+8$（選項 C）。為甚麼是 $1$？因為 $(x-b)\div(x-b)=1$ —— 抽走的只是那個括號，它仍然留有 $1$ 份。✓ 所以正確是 $(x-b-8)-1$，得到 $x=b+9$。一句記住：約簡後是 $1$，不是 $0$。
steps.en: ✗ Many students “simplify” $(x-b)$ to 0: writing $(x-b-8)-0$ gives $x=b+8$ (option C). Why 1? Because $(x-b)\div(x-b)=1$ — only the bracket is taken out and one copy of it stays. ✓ So it is $(x-b-8)-1$, giving $x=b+9$. Remember: the leftover is 1, not 0.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 每個因子各自等於 0，兩個根都要寫
title.en: Step 4 · Set each factor to zero; state both roots

steps.zh: 兩個因子都要寫：$x=b$ 或 $x=b+9$，答案是 D。
steps.en: Both factors give a root: $x=b$ or $x=b+9$. The answer is D.

traps.en: Option C comes from “simplifying” $(x-b)$ to 0: the leftover is $(x-b-8)-1$, not $(x-b-8)-0$. Cancelling gives 1, not 0.

traps.zh: 只寫 $x=b+8$：既漏了 $x-b=0$ 這個根，也把抽走之後剩下的 $1$ 寫成 $0$。
traps.en: Writing only $x=b+8$: the root $x=b$ is missing, and the leftover 1 was written as 0.

traps.zh: 只寫 $x=b+9$：漏掉 $x-b=0$ 這個根（兩邊約走 $(x-b)$ 就會得到這個錯）。
traps.en: Writing only $x=b+9$: the root $x-b=0$ is missing — the classic result of cancelling $(x-b)$.

tip.zh: 方程兩邊有同一個括號（或同一個 $x$）：先搬去一邊，再抽公因式；抽走之後剩下的是 $1$（不是 $0$），而且千萬不要兩邊約走。
tip.en: When both sides share a bracket (or an $x$): move everything to one side, then factor it out. The leftover is 1, not 0 — and never cancel it.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法
name.en: Substitution check

alt.en: Put $b=1$: the equation becomes $(x-1)(x-9)=(x-1)$, giving $x=1$ or $10$. Substituting $b=1$ into the options, only D gives $x=1$ or $10$.

eph-en01-m5.source: WS05 課堂題 · [HKDSE 2015 Paper 2 Q7 同款]

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先把 $\beta^{2}$ 變為主項（有分數是正常的）
title.en: Step 1 · Make $\beta^{2}$ the subject (a fraction is fine)

steps.zh: 「$\beta$ 是方程的根」＝代入之後等於 $0$：$3\beta^{2}-5\beta-7=0$。把 $3\beta^{2}$ 留在左邊，整條等式除以 $3$，得 $\beta^{2}=\frac{5\beta+7}{3}$。不需要求 $\beta$ 的數值（它是無理數）；有分數是正常的，下一步把它整塊代入。
steps.en: “$\beta$ is a root” means the substitution gives 0: $3\beta^{2}-5\beta-7=0$. Keep $3\beta^{2}$ on the left and divide the whole relation by 3: $\beta^{2}=\frac{5\beta+7}{3}$. Do not try to find $\beta$ itself — it is irrational.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 把這個分數整塊代入 $-6\beta^{2}$
title.en: Step 2 · Substitute the whole fraction into $-6\beta^{2}$

steps.zh: 目標式要 $-6\beta^{2}$：把 $\frac{5\beta+7}{3}$ 整塊乘 $-6$。分子 $(5\beta+7)$ 要整塊乘：$-6\times(5\beta+7)=-30\beta-42$，再與分母 $3$ 約簡：$-30\beta\div3=-10\beta$、$-42\div3=-14$，得 $-10\beta-14$。口訣：$-6\div3=-2$，所以也可以直接寫 $-2(5\beta+7)$。約簡時分子每一項都要除，只除 $\beta$ 項就會錯。
steps.en: The target contains $-6\beta^{2}$: multiply the whole fraction $\frac{5\beta+7}{3}$ by $-6$. Multiply the numerator as a whole: $-6\times(5\beta+7)=-30\beta-42$, then cancel the 3: $-30\beta\div3=-10\beta$ and $-42\div3=-14$, giving $-10\beta-14$. Shortcut: $-6\div3=-2$, so $-2(5\beta+7)$. Every term must be divided — not just the $\beta$ term.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 代回目標式化簡（$\beta$ 項會相消）
title.en: Step 3 · Substitute back and simplify (the $\beta$ terms cancel)

steps.zh: 代入得 $4+10\beta-10\beta-14$。$+10\beta$ 與 $-10\beta$ 相消，剩下 $4-14=-10$，答案是 A。
steps.en: This gives $4+10\beta-10\beta-14$. The $\beta$ terms cancel, leaving $4-14=-10$. The answer is A.

traps.en: $-3$ subtracts 7 once: $-2(5\beta+7)=-10\beta-14$, so the constant is $-14$, not $-7$.
$11$ is $4+7$: only the $\beta$ term was multiplied by $-2$ and the constant kept its $+7$.
$18$ is $4+14$: a sign slip turns the constant into $+14$.

tip.zh: 見到「已知一個根」：① 寫 $a\beta^{2}+b\beta+c=0$；② 整條除以 $a$，得 $\beta^{2}=\frac{\ldots}{a}$；③ 把這個分數整塊代入目標式 —— 分子每一項都要乘，約簡時每一項都要除。
tip.en: For any “given a root” question: (1) write $a\beta^{2}+b\beta+c=0$; (2) divide the whole relation by $a$ to get $\beta^{2}$ as a fraction; (3) substitute that whole fraction into the target — multiply every numerator term and divide every term when cancelling.

name.zh: 計算機保底：求根後 Ans 鍵秒殺法
name.en: Calculator safety net: Root finding and Ans key

eph-en01-m7.source: WS05 課後針對練習（自編）· 抽走共同括號後剩下的是 1，不是 0

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 搬去一邊：不要兩邊約走 $(x-c)$
title.en: Step 1 · Move everything to one side: never cancel $(x-c)$

steps.zh: 方程兩邊都有 $(x-c)$。約走它就等於假設 $x\ne c$，會失掉 $x=c$ 這個根。先把右邊那一份 $(x-c)$ 整塊搬去左邊。
steps.en: Both sides contain $(x-c)$. Cancelling it assumes $x\neq c$ and loses the root $x=c$. Move the whole $(x-c)$ across first.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 抽走 $(x-c)$：它剩下的是 1，不是 0
title.en: Step 2 · Factor out $(x-c)$: the leftover is 1, not 0

steps.zh: 搬過來的那一項是 $-1\times(x-c)$，所以抽走 $(x-c)$ 之後剩下 $1$：括號內是 $(x-c-5)-1$。✗ 若把 $(x-c)$ 當成 $0$，會寫成 $(x-c-5)-0$，得出 $x=c$ 或 $x=c+5$（選項 D）—— 這正是課堂上最常見的失分位。✓ 正確是 $(x-c-5)-1=x-c-6$。
steps.en: The term moved across is $-1\times(x-c)$, so it leaves 1 behind: the bracket reads $(x-c-5)-1$. ✗ Treating $(x-c)$ as 0 gives $(x-c-5)-0$, i.e. $x=c$ or $x=c+5$ (option D). ✓ Correct: $(x-c-5)-1=x-c-6$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 各自等於 0，兩個根都要寫
title.en: Step 3 · Set each factor to zero; state both roots

steps.zh: 兩個因子都要寫：$x=c$ 或 $x=c+6$，答案是 B。只寫一個根（選項 A、C）會失去答案分。
steps.en: Both factors give a root: $x=c$ or $x=c+6$. The answer is B.

traps.zh: 把 $(x-c)$ 當成 $0$（寫成 $(x-c-5)-0$）就會得出 $x=c$ 或 $x=c+5$。抽走 $(x-c)$ 之後剩下的是 $1$：$(x-c-5)-1=x-c-6$，所以另一個根是 $x=c+6$，不是 $c+5$。
traps.en: Treating $(x-c)$ as 0 gives $x=c$ or $x=c+5$. The leftover is 1: $(x-c-5)-1=x-c-6$, so the root is $x=c+6$.

traps.zh: $x=c+6$ 是兩邊約走 $(x-c)$ 的結果：約走 ＝ 假設 $x-c\ne 0$，會漏掉 $x=c$ 這個根。
traps.en: $x=c+6$ alone comes from cancelling $(x-c)$ on both sides, which loses the root $x=c$.

traps.zh: $x=c+5$ 是「把 $(x-c)$ 當成 $0$」之後又只寫一個根：既漏了 $x=c$，也把剩下的 $1$ 寫成 $0$。
traps.en: $x=c+5$ alone: the leftover 1 was written as 0, and the root $x=c$ is missing.

tip.zh: 兩邊有同一個括號：先搬去一邊，再抽公因式。抽走之後它剩下 $1$（因為 $(x-c)\div(x-c)=1$），不是 $0$；答案記得寫齊兩個根。
tip.en: When both sides share a bracket: move everything to one side, then factor it out. The leftover is 1, not 0 — and remember to write both roots.

name.zh: 卷二保底：數值代入法
name.en: Substitution check

alt.en: Put $c=1$: the equation becomes $(x-1)(x-6)=(x-1)$, giving $x=1$ or $7$. Substituting $c=1$ into the options, only B gives $x=1$ or $7$ (D gives $x=1$ or $6$ ✗).

name.zh: 另解：分兩種情況（先取公因式為 0，再約走）
name.en: Method 2: two cases (take the factor = 0 first, then cancel)

alt.zh:
① 先取 $(x-c)=0$ —— 兩邊都變成 $0$，所以 $x=c$ 是一個根；
② 其餘情況 $x-c\ne 0$，才可以兩邊約走 $(x-c)$：$x-c-5=1\ \Rightarrow\ x=c+6$。
兩個根齊全：$x=c$ 或 $x=c+6$。

eph-en01-m8.source: WS05 課後針對練習（自編）· 分數代入：分子要整塊乘，再與分母約簡

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先把 $\beta^{2}$ 變為主項（整條除以 3）
title.en: Step 1 · Make $\beta^{2}$ the subject (divide the whole relation by 3)

steps.zh: 「$\beta$ 是方程的根」＝代入之後等於 $0$。把 $3\beta^{2}$ 單獨留在左邊，再整條等式除以 $3$：$\beta^{2}=\frac{4\beta+1}{3}$。有分數是正常的，不要嘗試求 $\beta$ 的數值（它是無理數）。
steps.en: “$\beta$ is a root” means the substitution gives 0. Keep $3\beta^{2}$ on the left and divide the whole relation by 3: $\beta^{2}=\frac{4\beta+1}{3}$. A fraction is fine — do not try to find $\beta$ itself.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 分數整塊代入 $-6\beta^{2}$：分子每一項都要乘
title.en: Step 2 · Substitute the whole fraction into $-6\beta^{2}$: multiply every numerator term

steps.zh: 把 $\frac{4\beta+1}{3}$ 乘 $-6$：分子 $(4\beta+1)$ 整塊乘，$-6\times(4\beta+1)=-24\beta-6$；再與分母 $3$ 約簡：$-24\beta\div3=-8\beta$、$-6\div3=-2$，得 $-8\beta-2$。口訣：$-6\div3=-2$。分子每一項都要除 —— 漏了常數項就會寫成 $-8\beta-6$，答案會變成 $6$。
steps.en: Multiply $\frac{4\beta+1}{3}$ by $-6$: multiply the numerator as a whole, $-6\times(4\beta+1)=-24\beta-6$, then cancel the 3: $-24\beta\div3=-8\beta$ and $-6\div3=-2$, giving $-8\beta-2$. Every term must be divided — missing the constant gives $-8\beta-6$ and the wrong answer 6.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 代回目標式化簡（$\beta$ 項會相消）
title.en: Step 3 · Substitute back and simplify (the $\beta$ terms cancel)

steps.zh: 代入得 $12+8\beta-8\beta-2$。$+8\beta$ 與 $-8\beta$ 相消，剩下 $12-2=10$，答案是 C。
steps.en: This gives $12+8\beta-8\beta-2$. The $\beta$ terms cancel, leaving $12-2=10$. The answer is C.

traps.zh: $-2$ 是忘記了目標式開頭的 $12$：只計算 $-6\beta^{2}$ 的部分（$-8\beta-2$），$8\beta$ 相消之後就只剩 $-2$。
traps.en: $-2$ forgets the 12 at the front of the target: only $-6\beta^{2}$ was computed ($-8\beta-2$), leaving $-2$ after cancelling.

traps.zh: $6$ 是約簡時只除 $\beta$ 項：$-24\beta\div3=-8\beta$，但常數 $-6$ 忘了除 $3$（$-6\div3=-2$），寫成 $-8\beta-6$，於是 $12-6=6$。
traps.en: $6$ divides only the $\beta$ term: $-24\beta\div3=-8\beta$ but the constant $-6$ is not divided by 3, so $-8\beta-6$ gives $12-6=6$.
$13$ does not multiply the constant by $-2$: keeping $+1$ gives $-8\beta+1$, so $12+1=13$.

tip.zh: $\beta^{2}$ 是分數也可以直接代入：分子整塊乘，再與分母約簡，分子每一項都要除。最後 $\beta$ 項通常會相消，剩下的常數就是答案。
tip.en: A fractional $\beta^{2}$ can be substituted directly: multiply the whole numerator, then cancel with the denominator — every term must be divided. The $\beta$ terms then cancel out.

name.zh: 計算機保底：求根後 Ans 鍵秒殺法
name.en: Calculator safety net: Root finding and the Ans key

alt.zh: 用 Casio fx-50FH II 按【FMLA】【01】，輸入 $a=3, b=-4, c=-1$，求得根 $x \approx 1.549$。直接按鍵輸入 $12+8\text{Ans}-6\text{Ans}^{2}$ 按【EXE】，螢幕顯示 $10$，鎖定選項 C。
alt.en: On a Casio fx-50FH II press [FMLA] [01] with $a=3, b=-4, c=-1$ to get $x \approx 1.549$. Type $12+8\text{Ans}-6\text{Ans}^{2}$ and press [EXE]: the display shows $10$, confirming option C.

eph-en01-q1.source: WS05 課堂題（Basic Skills · 解方程）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 展開並移項，化為標準形
title.en: Step 1 · Expand and rearrange into standard form

steps.zh: 展開得 $14x-3x^{2}=8$。全部移至一邊並按降冪排列，使二次項係數為正：$3x^{2}-14x+8=0$。
steps.en: Expand to get $14x-3x^{2}=8$. Move all terms to one side in descending powers so that the coefficient of $x^{2}$ is positive: $3x^{2}-14x+8=0$.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 十字相乘因式分解
title.en: Step 2 · Factorise using the cross-method

steps.zh: 進行十字相乘：$(3x)(-4)+(-2)(x)=-14x$，成功因式分解為 $(3x-2)(x-4)=0$。此步驟為考評局必評方法分。
steps.en: Apply the cross-method: $(3x)(-4)+(-2)(x)=-14x$. Factorise into $(3x-2)(x-4)=0$. This step is an essential method mark.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 令各因式為零，寫出全部根
title.en: Step 3 · Set each factor to zero and state both roots

steps.zh: 分別解得 $x=\frac{2}{3}$ 或 $x=4$。必須寫齊「或 (or)」前後的兩個根，缺一不可。
steps.en: Solve to obtain $x=\frac{2}{3}$ or $x=4$. Both roots connected by “or” must be clearly stated.

traps.label: 兩邊約走 $x$
traps.zh: 把 $x(14-3x)=8$ 兩邊除 $x$ 得 $14-3x=\frac{8}{x}$，做不下去而且會走錯方向；展開搬項才是正路。
traps.en: Dividing both sides by $x$ gives $14-3x=\frac{8}{x}$ — a dead end. Expand and rearrange instead.

traps.label: 只寫一個根
traps.zh: $x=\frac{2}{3}$ 或 $x=4$ 兩個都要寫，評分要求「or」前後齊全。
traps.en: Both $x=\frac{2}{3}$ and $x=4$ are required: the marking demands both.

traps.label: 搬項漏變號
traps.zh: $-3x^{2}+14x-8=0$ 也可以，但要一致；最穩是把 $x^{2}$ 的係數寫正，避免十字相乘時符號錯。
traps.en: $-3x^{2}+14x-8=0$ is also valid, but be consistent; making the $x^{2}$ coefficient positive avoids sign slips in the cross-method.

tip.zh: 右邊不是 0 → 先搬去一邊；展開後按次方排好再十字相乘。
tip.en: If the right-hand side is not 0, move everything over first, then expand and write it in descending powers.

name.zh: 計算機保底：利用求根逆推因式分解步驟
name.en: Calculator safety net: Reverse-engineering factors from roots

alt.zh: 化為 $3x^{2}-14x+8=0$ 後若十字相乘有困難，可用 Casio fx-50FH II 按【FMLA】【01】輸入 $a=3, b=-14, c=8$。計算機顯示 $x_{1}=4$ 及 $x_{2}=\frac{2}{3}$。逆推口訣：整數根 $4$ 寫成 $(x-4)$；分數根 $\frac{2}{3}$ 將分母乘至 $x$ 前寫成 $(3x-2)$。將兩式相乘寫出 $(3x-2)(x-4)=0$，即可穩拿第 2 步方法分 (1M)！
alt.en: After rearranging to $3x^{2}-14x+8=0$, if factorisation is challenging, use Casio fx-50FH II [FMLA] [01] with $a=3, b=-14, c=8$. The calculator outputs $x_{1}=4$ and $x_{2}=\frac{2}{3}$. Reverse rule: the integer root $4$ gives the factor $(x-4)$; the fraction root $\frac{2}{3}$ puts the denominator before $x$, giving $(3x-2)$. Writing $(3x-2)(x-4)=0$ secures the method mark (1M).

eph-en01-q2.source: WS05 課堂題（Basic Skills · 解方程）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 展開並移項整理
title.en: Step 1 · Expand and rearrange

steps.zh: 兩邊分別展開得 $2x^{2}+3x=x^{2}-5x$。千萬不可兩邊同除以 $x$（會漏解 $x=0$）。移項整理得 $x^{2}+8x=0$。
steps.en: Expand both sides to obtain $2x^{2}+3x=x^{2}-5x$. Never divide both sides by $x$, as that loses the root $x=0$. Rearrange to get $x^{2}+8x=0$.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 提取公因式
title.en: Step 2 · Factor out the common factor

steps.zh: 常數項為 0，直接提取公因式 $x$，得 $x(x+8)=0$。此因式分解步驟為關鍵方法分。
steps.en: Since the constant term is 0, factor out $x$ directly to obtain $x(x+8)=0$. This factorisation is an essential method mark.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 各因式等於零，寫出兩根
title.en: Step 3 · Set each factor to zero and state both roots

steps.zh: 得出 $x=0$ 或 $x=-8$。兩個根必須完整寫出，只寫一個會失去答案分。
steps.en: Obtain $x=0$ or $x=-8$. Both roots must be stated clearly; omitting either loses the answer mark.

traps.label: 兩邊約走 $x$
traps.zh: 約走就只剩 $2x+3=x-5$ → $x=-8$，失去了 $x=0$ 這個根 —— 這是最常見的失分位。
traps.en: Cancelling leaves $2x+3=x-5$, i.e. $x=-8$ only — the root $x=0$ is lost. The most common way to lose a mark.

traps.label: 搬項符號錯
traps.zh: $-5x$ 搬去左邊變 $+5x$；漏了變號就會得到 $x^{2}-2x=0$，答案跟着錯。
traps.en: Moving $-5x$ across makes it $+5x$; missing that gives $x^{2}-2x=0$ and a wrong answer.

traps.label: 只寫一個根
traps.zh: 答案一定要寫「$x=0$ 或 $x=-8$」。
traps.en: The answer must read “$x=0$ or $x=-8$”.

tip.zh: 方程兩邊都有 $x$：展開 → 搬去一邊 → 抽公因式，永遠不要約走 $x$。
tip.en: When both sides contain $x$: expand, move to one side, factor out $x$ — never cancel.

name.zh: 驗算法：把根代回原方程（做完自己檢查）
name.en: Check: substitute the roots back into the equation

alt.en: Substitute each root back into the original equation: for $x=0$, LHS $=0(3)=0$ and RHS $=0(-5)=0$, LHS $=$ RHS; for $x=-8$, LHS $=-8(2(-8)+3)=-8(-13)=104$ and RHS $=-8(-8-5)=-8(-13)=104$, LHS $=$ RHS. Both roots satisfy the equation, confirming no arithmetic error or missing roots.

name.zh: 另解：分兩種情況（先取公因式為 0，再約走）
name.en: Method 2: two cases (take the factor = 0 first, then cancel)

alt.zh:
分兩種情況（不必移項，也不必抽公因式）：
① 先取公因式 $x=0$ —— 兩邊都變成 $0$，方程自動成立，所以 $x=0$ 是一個根；
② 其餘情況 $x\ne 0$，才可以放心兩邊約走 $x$：$2x+3=x-5\ \Rightarrow\ x=-8$。
兩個根齊全：$x=0$ 或 $x=-8$。
alt.en:
Two cases (no need to move terms or factor out):
(1) take the common factor $x=0$ — both sides become $0$, so the equation holds automatically and $x=0$ is a root;
(2) in every other case $x\ne 0$, so you may safely cancel $x$ on both sides: $2x+3=x-5\ \Rightarrow\ x=-8$.
Both roots: $x=0$ or $x=-8$.

eph-en01-q3.source: WS05 課堂題 · [HKDSE Practice Paper 1 Q17(b)(ii)]（2 marks）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 寫成標準形 $ax^{2}+bx+c=0$
title.en: Step 1 · Write in standard form $ax^{2}+bx+c=0$

steps.zh: 將 $r$ 移至左邊，常數項為 $(9-r)$。注意 $a=1, b=-4, c=9-r$。
steps.en: Move $r$ to the left side so the constant term is $(9-r)$. Here $a=1, b=-4, c=9-r$.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 方程有實根即 $\Delta\ge 0$
title.en: Step 2 · Real roots condition $\Delta\ge 0$

steps.zh: 題目指出方程有實根，即判別式 $\Delta\ge 0$（包含等根，務必帶等號）。代入係數並展開化簡得 $4r-20\ge 0$。
steps.en: The equation has real roots, which implies $\Delta\ge 0$ (including equal roots, must have the equality sign). Substitute coefficients to obtain $4r-20\ge 0$.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 解不等式求範圍
title.en: Step 3 · Solve the inequality for the range

steps.zh: 兩邊同除以 4，得 $r\ge 5$。取值範圍必須以不等式形式完整作答。
steps.en: Divide both sides by 4 to get $r\ge 5$. The range of values must be stated as an inequality.

traps.label: 常數項漏了 $-r$
traps.labelEn: Forgetting the $-r$ in the constant term
traps.zh: 用 $c=9$ 會得到 $16-36=-20\ge 0$，明顯不可能 —— 那就代表搬項搬錯了。
traps.en: Using $c=9$ gives $16-36=-20\ge 0$, which is impossible — a sign you moved the terms wrongly.

traps.label: 方向錯：寫成 $\Delta>0$
traps.zh: 「有實根」包含「兩個相等實根」，所以是 $\Delta\ge 0$（有等號）。
traps.en: “Real roots” includes the equal-roots case, so it is $\Delta\ge 0$ (with the equality).

traps.label: 只寫一個數
traps.zh: $r\ge 5$ 是一條不等式；只寫 $5$ 不會得分。
traps.en: $r\ge 5$ is an inequality; writing just $5$ scores nothing.

tip.zh: 「有實根」＝$\Delta\ge 0$；先把 $r$（或 $k$）併入常數項才代入判別式。
tip.en: “Real roots” means $\Delta\ge 0$; fold $r$ (or $k$) into the constant term before using the discriminant.

name.zh: 驗算法：範圍內外各取一個數核對
name.en: Check: test one value inside and one outside the range

alt.en: Answer $r\ge 5$: take $r=6$ giving $x^{2}-4x+3=0$ with $\Delta=4>0$ ✓ (real roots); take $r=4$ (outside) giving $x^{2}-4x+5=0$ with $\Delta=-4<0$ ✗. One inside and one outside confirms the range.

eph-en01-q4.source: WS05 課堂題（判別式：求 $k$ 的範圍）

title.zh: (a) 直接代判別式
title.en: (a) Apply the discriminant directly

steps.zh: 方程已經是標準形，$a=1$、$b=8$、$c=-k$。注意 $c$ 是 $-k$，所以 $-4ac=+4k$。
steps.en: The equation is already in standard form with $a=1$, $b=8$, $c=-k$. Since $c=-k$, we get $-4ac=+4k$.

title.zh: (a) 寫出範圍
title.en: (a) State the range

title.zh: (b) 先搬成標準形
title.en: (b) First write it in standard form

steps.zh: 把 $1$ 搬去左邊：常數項是 $k-1$（不是 $k$）—— 這一步是 (b) 的關鍵。
steps.en: Move the 1 across: the constant term is $k-1$, not $k$ — the key step of part (b).

title.zh: (b) 判別式並解不等式
title.en: (b) Use the discriminant and solve

steps.zh: $24-8k\ge 0 \Rightarrow 8k\le 24 \Rightarrow k\le 3$。留意除以負數會令不等號反方向（這裡是把 $-8k$ 搬去右邊，不用反號）。
steps.en: $24-8k\ge 0 \Rightarrow 8k\le 24 \Rightarrow k\le 3$. (Moving $-8k$ to the right avoids dividing by a negative number.)

traps.label: (b) 常數項用 $k$ 而不是 $k-1$
traps.zh: $k=1$ 搬去左邊後是 $-1$，所以 $c=k-1$；用 $c=k$ 會得到 $k\le 2$（錯）。
traps.en: Moving the 1 across gives $-1$, so $c=k-1$; using $c=k$ gives $k\le 2$, which is wrong.

traps.label: (a) 符號：$c=-k$ 寫成 $c=k$
traps.zh: $c=-k$ 時 $-4ac=+4k$，答案 $k\ge -16$；寫成 $c=k$ 會得到 $k\le 16$。
traps.en: With $c=-k$ we get $-4ac=+4k$ and $k\ge -16$; using $c=k$ gives $k\le 16$.

traps.label: 不等號方向錯
traps.zh: 解到 $k\le 3$ 時，把 $-8k$ 搬去右邊（不要兩邊除 $-8$）就不會反號。
traps.en: Moving $-8k$ to the right (instead of dividing by $-8$) keeps the inequality direction correct.

tip.zh: 兩步固定：(1) 先寫成 $ax^{2}+bx+c=0$（$k$ 併入常數項）；(2) 代 $\Delta\ge 0$ 解不等式。
tip.en: Two fixed moves: write $ax^{2}+bx+c=0$ with $k$ inside the constant term, then apply $\Delta\ge 0$ and solve the inequality.

name.zh: 驗算法：範圍內外各取一個數核對
name.en: Check: test one value inside and one outside the range

alt.en: For (b)'s answer $k\le 3$, test one value inside and one outside: $k=2$ gives $2x^{2}-4x+1=0$ with $\Delta=8>0$ ✓; $k=4$ gives $2x^{2}-4x+3=0$ with $\Delta=-8<0$ ✗.

eph-en02-q1.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q19 · EPH WS05 Q19（判別式：兩個相等實根）

title.zh: 第 1 步 (a) · 相等實根 ⇒ $\Delta=0$
title.en: (a) Equal real roots means the discriminant is zero

steps.zh: 「有兩個相等實根」＝判別式 $\Delta=b^{2}-4ac=0$。這裡 $a=1$、$b=4$、$c=k$（$k$ 本身就是常數項），代入得 $16-4k=0$。
steps.en: Two equal real roots means the discriminant is 0. Here a = 1, b = 4 and c = k, so 16 - 4k = 0.

title.zh: 第 2 步 (a) · 解方程求 $k$
title.en: (a) Solve the equation for k

steps.zh: 把 $-4k$ 搬去右邊得 $4k=16$，所以 $k=4$。不要兩邊同除 $-4$，就不會弄錯符號。
steps.en: Move -4k to the right: 4k = 16, so k = 4. Avoid dividing by -4, which invites sign errors.

title.zh: 第 3 步 (b) · 二次項係數是 $k$：先認清 $a$、$b$、$c$
title.en: (b) The coefficient of x squared is k: identify a, b and c first

steps.zh: 方程 $kx^{2}-30x+9=0$ 的 $a=k$（不是 $1$）、$b=-30$（連負號）、$c=9$。代入 $\Delta=b^{2}-4ac$ 得 $900-36k$。（順帶一提：$k\ne 0$，否則方程不再是二次方程。）
steps.en: In kx^2 - 30x + 9 = 0 we have a = k, b = -30 with its sign, and c = 9; the discriminant is 900 - 36k. Note k must not be 0.

title.zh: 第 4 步 (b) · 令 $\Delta=0$ 解出 $k$
title.en: (b) Set the discriminant to zero and solve

steps.zh: 相等實根 ⇒ $\Delta=0$：$36k=900$，所以 $k=25$。兩個答案一起寫：$k=4$ 或 $k=25$。
steps.en: Equal roots means 900 - 36k = 0, hence 36k = 900 and k = 25.

traps.label: 二次項係數看錯
traps.zh: (b) 把 $a$ 當成 $1$，得 $900-36=864$；這樣怎樣解也得不到 $k=25$。$a$ 含 $k$ 時一定要整塊代入。
traps.en: Treating a as 1 in part (b) leaves 864 instead of 900 - 36k, so k = 25 can never appear.

traps.label: 等根誤用 $\Delta>0$
traps.labelEn: Using a strict inequality for equal roots
traps.zh: 「兩個相等實根」是 $\Delta=0$（一個等號）；$\Delta>0$ 才是「兩個相異實根」。
traps.en: Two equal real roots gives the discriminant equal to zero; a strict inequality describes two distinct roots.

traps.label: 搬項忘記變號
traps.en: 16 - 4k = 0 gives 4k = 16 and k = 4; dividing by -4 carelessly produces k = -4 instead.

tip.zh: 「相等實根」＝ $\Delta=0$。先把方程寫成標準形，再把 $a$、$b$、$c$ 連符號整塊代入 —— 二次項係數含 $k$ 時最容易漏。
tip.en: Equal roots means the discriminant is zero. Write the equation in standard form first, then substitute a, b and c with their signs; a coefficient containing k is the easiest one to drop.

name.zh: 驗算法：把 $k$ 代回，看是否真的重根
name.en: Check: substitute each k back and test for a repeated root

alt.en: Put k = 4 back into (a): x^2 + 4x + 4 = 0 is (x + 2)^2 = 0, a repeated root at x = -2. Put k = 25 back into (b) and check with the calculator that both roots coincide, which confirms the discriminant is zero.

eph-en02-q2.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q20 · EPH WS05 Q20（判別式：求 k 的範圍）

title.zh: 第 1 步 (a) · 無實根 ⇒ $\Delta<0$
title.en: (a) No real roots means the discriminant is negative

steps.zh: 「無實根」＝判別式 $\Delta<0$（嚴格小於，沒有等號）。$a=1$、$b=-6$、$c=k$，而 $(-6)^{2}=36$（負數平方得正）。
steps.en: No real roots means the discriminant is strictly negative. Here a = 1, b = -6 and c = k, and (-6)^2 = 36.

title.zh: 第 2 步 (a) · 解不等式，寫出範圍
title.en: (a) Solve the inequality and state the range

steps.zh: 把 $-4k$ 搬去右邊（不要兩邊除 $-4$，就不會反號）：$36<4k$，兩邊同除 $4$ 得 $k>9$。答案要寫成不等式。
steps.en: Move -4k across instead of dividing by a negative number: 36 < 4k, so k > 9. The answer must be written as an inequality.

title.en: (b) Identify a, b and c: here c is minus k

steps.zh: 「有兩個相異實根」＝$\Delta>0$。$c=-k$，所以 $-4ac=-4(9)(-k)=+36k$ —— 負負得正，這一步最容易漏掉。
steps.en: Two unequal real roots means the discriminant is positive. Since c = -k, the term -4ac becomes +36k; the double negative is the usual slip.

title.zh: 第 4 步 (b) · 解出 $k$ 的範圍
title.en: (b) Solve for the range of k

steps.zh: 把 $9$ 搬去右邊得 $36k>-9$，兩邊同除 $36$（正數，不等號不變）得 $k>-\frac{1}{4}$。
steps.en: Move 9 across to get 36k > -9, then divide by the positive number 36: k > -1/4.

traps.label: 無實根寫成 $\Delta\le 0$
traps.labelEn: Writing the no-real-roots condition with an equality
traps.zh: 「無實根」是 $\Delta<0$；寫成 $\Delta\le 0$ 會多包了一個 $k=9$ —— 那時方程有重根，不是無實根。
traps.en: No real roots means the discriminant is strictly negative; including the equality would wrongly accept the repeated-root case.

traps.label: (b) 漏了 $c=-k$ 的負號
traps.zh: $c=-k$ 時 $-4ac=+36k$，答案是 $k>-\frac{1}{4}$；把 $c$ 當成 $k$ 就得 $9-36k>0$，答案變成 $k<\frac{1}{4}$（剛好相反）。
traps.en: With c = -k the discriminant is 9 + 36k, giving k > -1/4; treating c as k gives the opposite answer.

traps.label: (b) 忘記 $a=9$
traps.en: Using a = 1 gives 9 + 4k > 0 instead, so the range becomes k > -9/4.

tip.zh: 三個字眼要分清：「無實根」$\Delta<0$、「兩個相異實根」$\Delta>0$、「有實根」$\Delta\ge 0$。解不等式時把負項搬去另一邊，就不會反號。
tip.en: Keep the three wordings apart: no real roots gives a negative discriminant, two unequal roots a positive one, and real roots allow the equality. Move negative terms across instead of dividing by them.

name.zh: 驗算法：範圍內外各取一個數核對
name.en: Check: test one value inside and one outside the range

alt.zh: 取 (b) 的答案 $k>-\frac{1}{4}$ 內外各一：$k=0$ 時 $9x^{2}+3x=0$，$\Delta=9>0$ ✓ 兩個相異實根；$k=-1$ 時 $9x^{2}+3x+1=0$，$\Delta=9-36=-27<0$ ✗ 無實根。一正一反就確認範圍正確。
alt.en: For the answer k > -1/4, test one value inside and one outside: k = 0 gives 9x^2 + 3x = 0 with a positive discriminant, while k = -1 gives a negative discriminant. One inside and one outside confirms the range.

eph-en02-q3.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q21 · EPH WS05 Q21（判別式：有實根）

title.zh: 第 1 步 (a) · 有實根 ⇒ $\Delta\ge 0$
title.en: (a) Real roots means the discriminant is at least zero

steps.zh: 「有實根」＝$\Delta\ge 0$（等號不可漏：等根也算有實根）。$c=-k$，所以 $-4ac=-4(1)(-k)=+4k$。
steps.en: Real roots means the discriminant is greater than or equal to 0. Since c = -k, the term -4ac equals +4k.

title.zh: 第 2 步 (a) · 寫出 $k$ 的範圍
title.en: (a) State the range of k

steps.zh: 把 $64$ 搬去右邊得 $4k\ge -64$，同除 $4$ 得 $k\ge -16$。
steps.en: Move 64 across to get 4k at least -64, so k is at least -16.

title.zh: 第 3 步 (b) · 先搬成標準形，常數項是 $k-1$
title.en: (b) Write it in standard form: the constant term is k minus 1

steps.zh: 右邊的 $1$ 搬去左邊才做判別式：常數項是 $(k-1)$，不是 $k$。這一步是 (b) 的關鍵。
steps.en: Move the 1 across before using the discriminant: the constant term is k - 1, not k. This is the key step of part (b).

title.zh: 第 4 步 (b) · 判別式 $\ge 0$ 並解不等式
title.en: (b) Apply the discriminant and solve the inequality

steps.zh: $16-8k+8=24-8k\ge 0$，把 $-8k$ 搬去右邊得 $24\ge 8k$，即 $k\le 3$。（搬項就不會兩邊除負數反號。）
steps.en: The discriminant is 24 - 8k, which must be at least 0, so k is at most 3. Moving the negative term across keeps the inequality direction.

traps.label: (b) 常數項用 $k$ 而不是 $k-1$
traps.zh: 用 $c=k$ 得 $16-8k\ge 0$，即 $k\le 2$ —— 差了一格，這是最常見的失分位。
traps.en: Using c = k gives 16 - 8k at least 0, hence k at most 2, which is wrong by one step.

traps.label: (a) 符號：$c=-k$ 寫成 $c=k$
traps.labelEn: (a) Sign slip: writing c = k instead of -k
traps.zh: $c=-k$ 時 $-4ac=+4k$，答案 $k\ge -16$；寫成 $c=k$ 會得 $k\le 16$。
traps.en: With c = -k we get +4k and the range k at least -16; using c = k reverses it.

traps.label: 「有實根」漏等號
traps.labelEn: Dropping the equality for real roots
traps.zh: 寫成 $\Delta>0$ 會漏掉 $k=-16$ —— 那時方程有重根，仍然算有實根。
traps.en: Using a strict inequality loses k = -16, where the equation has a repeated root and still counts as having real roots.

tip.zh: 有實根＝$\Delta\ge 0$（有等號）。記得先把 $k$ 搬進常數項，再代入判別式。
tip.en: Real roots means the discriminant is at least zero, equality included. Fold k into the constant term before substituting.

name.zh: 驗算法：範圍內外各取一個數核對
name.en: Check: test one value inside and one outside the range

alt.en: For the answer k at most 3, test k = 2 and k = 4: the first has a positive discriminant and the second a negative one, confirming the boundary.

eph-en02-q4.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q7 · EPH WS05 DSE P1 Q7 · [HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q17(a)]（3 marks）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 寫下兩根之和與兩根之積
title.en: Step 1 · Write down the sum and the product of the roots

steps.zh: 根與係數：$\alpha+\beta=-\frac{b}{a}$、$\alpha\beta=\frac{c}{a}$。這裡 $a=1$、$b=k$、$c=-15$，所以 $\alpha+\beta=-k$、$\alpha\beta=-15$。不需要（也不應該）解方程。
steps.en: For roots alpha and beta: their sum is minus b over a and their product is c over a. With a = 1, b = k and c = -15 we get -k and -15. Never solve the equation itself.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用恆等式拆開 $\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}$
title.en: Step 2 · Split the target with the standard identity

steps.zh: 由 $(\alpha+\beta)^{2}=\alpha^{2}+2\alpha\beta+\beta^{2}$ 移項就得到這條恆等式：目標式要先用「和」與「積」表示，才可以代入。
steps.en: This identity follows from expanding the square of the sum: the target must first be written using the sum and the product.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 代入並化簡（連符號）
title.en: Step 3 · Substitute with the signs and simplify

steps.en: The square of -k is k squared, and minus twice -15 is plus 30, so the answer is k squared plus 30.

traps.label: 硬解方程求根
traps.labelEn: Trying to solve the equation for the roots
traps.zh: 解 $x^{2}+kx-15=0$ 要求根式（還帶着 $k$），又慢又易錯。題目只要求「以 $k$ 表示」，用根與係數兩步就完成。
traps.en: Solving the equation would produce surds containing k: slow and error-prone. The question only asks for an expression in k.

traps.label: $\alpha\beta$ 漏了負號
traps.labelEn: Dropping the sign of the product
traps.en: Since c = -15 the product is -15; using +15 gives k squared minus 30 instead.

traps.label: $(-k)^{2}$ 寫成 $-k^{2}$
traps.labelEn: Writing -k squared as minus k squared
traps.zh: 負數平方是正數：$(-k)^{2}=k^{2}$。漏了這個符號，整題就錯。
traps.en: Squaring a negative number gives a positive result, so -k squared is k squared; a missing sign ruins the whole answer.

tip.zh: 看到「兩根是 $\alpha$ 和 $\beta$」：① 寫 $\alpha+\beta$、$\alpha\beta$（連符號）；② 用 $\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}=(\alpha+\beta)^{2}-2\alpha\beta$；③ 代入化簡。
tip.en: When a question gives the roots as alpha and beta: write down the sum and the product with their signs, apply the identity for the sum of squares, then substitute and simplify.

name.zh: 驗算法：代一個具體的 $k$ 核對
name.en: Check: pick a number for k and test the answer

alt.en: Take k = 2: the equation becomes x^2 + 2x - 15 = 0, whose roots are -5 and 3, so the sum of squares is 34. The formula gives 4 + 30 = 34 as well.

eph-en02-q5.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q8 · EPH WS05 DSE P1 Q8（2022 P1 Q17(a) 同款變式，3 marks）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 和與積（注意方程的係數是 $-b$）
title.en: Step 1 · Sum and product (the coefficient is minus b)

steps.zh: $a=2$、一次項係數是 $-b$（方程寫作 $-bx$），所以 $\alpha+\beta=-\frac{-b}{2}=\frac{b}{2}$；兩根之積 $\alpha\beta=\frac{c}{a}=\frac{8}{2}=4$。
steps.en: Here a = 2 and the coefficient of x is -b, so the sum of the roots is b over 2, and the product is 8 over 2, which is 4.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用恆等式把目標式寫成和與積
title.en: Step 2 · Rewrite the target with the sum and the product

steps.zh: 與上一題同一條恆等式：先把 $\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}$ 寫成 $(\alpha+\beta)^{2}-2\alpha\beta$，才可以代入剛剛算出的和與積。
steps.en: Same identity as the previous question: rewrite the sum of squares as the square of the sum minus twice the product before substituting.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 代入化簡
title.en: Step 3 · Substitute and simplify

steps.en: The square of b over 2 is b squared over 4, and minus twice 4 is minus 8, so the answer is b squared over 4 minus 8.

traps.label: 和式的符號
traps.zh: 方程是 $2x^{2}-bx+8=0$，一次項係數是 $-b$，所以 $\alpha+\beta=-\frac{-b}{2}=+\frac{b}{2}$；漏了一個負號就會寫成 $-\frac{b}{2}$。
traps.en: The coefficient of x is -b, so the sum of the roots is plus b over 2. Missing the double negative gives the wrong sign.

traps.label: 忘記 $a=2$
traps.zh: 用 $a=1$ 得 $\alpha+\beta=b$，答案變成 $b^{2}-8$。
traps.en: Using a = 1 gives a sum of b and therefore a different answer, b squared minus 8.

traps.label: 乘積忘了除 $a$
traps.labelEn: Forgetting to divide the product by a
traps.en: The product is 8 over 2, which is 4 and not 8; using 8 gives a wrong constant term.

tip.zh: 公式 $\alpha+\beta=-\frac{b}{a}$ 裡的 $b$ 是方程的一次項係數（連符號），與題目裡的常數 $b$ 同名但不是同一回事 —— 代入時逐個對清楚。
tip.en: In the formula the letter b means the coefficient of x in the equation, with its sign; it is not the same as the constant b in the question, so match every symbol carefully.

name.zh: 驗算法：代一個具體的 $b$ 核對
name.en: Check: pick a number for b and test the answer

alt.en: Take b = 10: the equation 2x^2 - 10x + 8 = 0 has roots 1 and 4, so the sum of squares is 17, which matches the formula 100 over 4 minus 8.

eph-en02-q6.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q14–16 · EPH WS05 Q14–16（複數化簡：寫成 a+bi）

title.zh: 第 1 步 (a) · 去括號：減號要分配給每一項
title.en: (a) Remove the brackets: the minus sign applies to every term

steps.zh: $-(6-7i)=-6+7i$：括號前的減號要乘進每一項，$-(-7i)=+7i$ 是最易錯的一步。
steps.en: The minus sign in front of the bracket multiplies every term inside, so -(-7i) becomes +7i.

title.zh: 第 2 步 (a) · 合併實部與虛部
title.en: (a) Combine the real parts and the imaginary parts

steps.en: The real parts give -2 and the imaginary parts give 12, so the answer is -2 + 12i.

title.zh: 第 3 步 (b) · 展開（每一項都要乘）
title.en: (b) Expand, multiplying every pair of terms

steps.zh: 逐項相乘：$1\times3=3$、$1\times4i=4i$、$-2i\times3=-6i$、$-2i\times4i=-8i^{2}$。四項都要寫出來才不會漏。
steps.en: Multiply term by term: 3, 4i, -6i and -8i squared. Writing all four terms down prevents omissions.

title.en: (b) Finish with i squared equal to minus one

steps.en: Minus 8 i squared becomes plus 8, so the real part is 11 and the imaginary part is -2, giving 11 - 2i.

title.zh: 第 5 步 (c) · 分母有 $i$：分子分母同乘共軛
title.en: (c) The denominator contains i: multiply by its conjugate

steps.zh: 分母 $7+i$ 的共軛是 $7-i$（把 $+i$ 換成 $-i$）。分子分母同乘它，分母就會變成實數。
steps.en: The conjugate of 7 + i is 7 - i. Multiplying the top and the bottom by it makes the denominator real.

title.zh: 第 6 步 (c) · 分母用平方差、分子展開
title.en: (c) Use the difference of squares below and expand above

steps.en: The denominator becomes 49 plus 1, which is 50, and the numerator becomes 15 + 5i because minus i squared is plus 1.

title.zh: 第 7 步 (c) · 約簡並分成 $a+bi$ 兩份
title.en: (c) Simplify and split into the form a + bi

steps.zh: 分子分母同除 $5$：$\frac{15+5i}{50}=\frac{3+i}{10}$。題目要求 $a+bi$，所以要把兩項分開寫成 $\frac{3}{10}+\frac{1}{10}i$。
steps.en: Dividing top and bottom by 5 gives three tenths plus one tenth i, with the real and imaginary parts written separately.

traps.label: (a) 減號只乘第一項
traps.labelEn: (a) Applying the minus sign to the first term only
traps.en: Writing the bracket as -6 - 7i leaves the imaginary part as 5 - 7, giving the wrong answer -2 - 2i.

traps.label: (b) 漏了 $-2i\times4i=-8i^{2}=+8$
traps.zh: 少了 $+8$，實部只餘 $3$，答案會寫成 $3-2i$。展開時四項要齊。
traps.en: Without that plus 8 the real part stays at 3, so the answer becomes 3 - 2i. All four products must be written down.

traps.label: (c) 分母寫成 $7^{2}-1^{2}=48$
traps.en: The product is 49 plus 1, which is 50, because minus i squared is plus 1; writing 49 - 1 is the usual slip and spoils the simplification.

tip.zh: 複數化簡三步：① 展開時 $i^{2}$ 全部換成 $-1$；② 分母有 $i$ 就乘共軛，分母變成 $c^{2}+d^{2}$；③ 最後一定要寫成 $a+bi$ 兩份。
tip.en: Three steps for simplifying complex numbers: replace every i squared by minus 1, multiply by the conjugate when the denominator contains i, and finish with the real and imaginary parts written separately.

name.zh: 驗算法：(c) 用計算機以 $i$ 的形式核對
name.en: Check: verify part (c) with a calculator

alt.zh: 把 $\frac{2+i}{7+i}$ 的分子分母同乘 $7-i$ 的結果 $\frac{15+5i}{50}$ 再約簡：$\frac{15}{50}=0.3$、$\frac{5}{50}=0.1$，與 $\frac{3}{10}+\frac{1}{10}i$ 一致。也可以用計算機的複數模式輸入 $(2+i)\div(7+i)$ 核對。
alt.en: The fraction reduces to three tenths plus one tenth i, which is 0.3 + 0.1i, and a calculator in complex mode can confirm the same value.

eph-en02-q7.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q17 · EPH WS05 Q17（複數的實部與虛部）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先處理分數：分子分母同乘 $-i$
title.en: Step 1 · Deal with the fraction: multiply by minus i

steps.zh: 分母只有 $i$：分子分母同乘 $-i$，因為 $i\times(-i)=-i^{2}=1$，分母立即變成 $1$。
steps.en: The denominator is just i, so multiply top and bottom by minus i: the denominator becomes 1 because i times minus i is 1.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用 $i^{2}=-1$ 化簡這一部分
title.en: Step 2 · Simplify using i squared equal to minus one

steps.en: Minus 3 i squared becomes plus 3, so the fraction equals 3 - 4i.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 代回原式，讀出實部與虛部
title.en: Step 3 · Substitute back and read off both parts

steps.en: The minus sign applies to both terms, so the expression becomes 2 + 4i: the real part is 2 and the imaginary part is 4.

traps.label: 忘了減號分配
traps.labelEn: Forgetting to distribute the minus sign
traps.en: Writing 5 - 3 - 4i gives 2 - 4i, so the imaginary part has the wrong sign.

traps.label: 問實部答了虛部
traps.labelEn: Answering the imaginary part when the real part was asked
traps.zh: 題目同時問 real part 與 imaginary part，兩個都要寫（$2$ 與 $4$）。只寫一個不會得分。
traps.en: The question asks for both parts, so both 2 and 4 must be stated; a single value scores nothing.

traps.label: 分母乘錯
traps.zh: 乘 $i$ 也可以：$\frac{(4+3i)i}{i\cdot i}=\frac{4i+3i^{2}}{-1}=\frac{-3+4i}{-1}=3-4i$，但分母是 $-1$，要小心符號。
traps.en: Multiplying by i also works but leaves minus 1 in the denominator, so the signs need extra care.

tip.zh: 分母只有 $i$ 時，分子分母同乘 $-i$ 就令分母變成實數；乘 $i$ 也可以，但分母變成 $-1$。最後代回原式要小心減號分配。
tip.en: When the denominator is just i, multiply top and bottom by minus i to make it real; multiplying by i works too but leaves minus 1 below. Watch the minus sign when substituting back.

name.zh: 驗算法：用 $i$ 的定義直接核對
name.en: Check: verify directly from the definition of i

alt.zh: 因為 $\frac{1}{i}=-i$，所以 $\frac{4+3i}{i}=(4+3i)(-i)=-4i-3i^{2}=3-4i$，與第 2 步相同；再用計算機複數模式輸入 $5-(4+3i)\div i$ 應得 $2+4i$。
alt.en: Since one over i is minus i, the fraction equals 3 - 4i exactly as above; a calculator in complex mode returns 2 + 4i for the whole expression.

eph-en02-q8.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q18 · EPH WS05 Q18（複數：已知是實數求 k）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 分子分母同乘分母的共軛 $1-2i$
title.en: Step 1 · Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate 1 - 2i

steps.zh: 分母 $1+2i$ 的共軛是 $1-2i$。乘完之後分母會變成實數 $1^{2}+2^{2}=5$，分子不要漏乘任何一項。
steps.en: The conjugate of 1 + 2i is 1 - 2i. The denominator then becomes 1 + 4, which is 5, and every numerator term must be multiplied.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 化簡成 $a+bi$
title.en: Step 2 · Simplify into the form a + bi

steps.en: Expanding the numerator gives k - 2 minus 2k + 1 times i, all divided by 5, so the imaginary part is minus 2k + 1 over 5.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 「是實數」⇒ 虛部 $=0$
title.en: Step 3 · Being real means the imaginary part is zero

steps.zh: 實數的虛部是 $0$：$-\frac{2k+1}{5}=0$，即 $2k+1=0$，所以 $k=-\frac{1}{2}$。（驗算：代入後虛部是 $0$，整個複數就是實部 $\frac{k-2}{5}$，確實是實數。）
steps.en: A real number has zero imaginary part, so 2k + 1 is zero and k is minus one half; substituting back leaves a purely real value.

traps.label: 分母符號：$(1+2i)(1-2i)=5$
traps.en: The product equals 1 plus 4, which is 5, because minus i squared is plus 1; writing 1 - 4 is the usual mistake.

traps.label: 令實部 $=0$（純虛數）
traps.labelEn: Setting the real part to zero instead
traps.zh: 「是實數」＝虛部 $=0$；若令實部 $=0$（那是「純虛數」的條件）就會得 $k=2$，完全相反。
traps.en: Being real means the imaginary part is zero; setting the real part to zero describes a purely imaginary number and gives k = 2 instead.

traps.label: 分子符號錯
traps.en: The last term of the expansion is plus 2 i squared, which is minus 2 and not plus 2.

tip.zh: 「是實數」＝虛部 $=0$；「是純虛數」＝實部 $=0$。分母有 $i$ 就先乘共軛化簡，再讀虛部。
tip.en: Being real means the imaginary part is zero, while being purely imaginary means the real part is zero. Multiply by the conjugate first, then read off the imaginary part.

name.zh: 驗算法：把 $k$ 代回，用計算機複數模式核對
name.en: Check: substitute k back and use complex mode

alt.zh: 把 $k=-\frac{1}{2}$ 代回：$\frac{-0.5-i}{1+2i}$ 用計算機複數模式計算，結果是 $-0.5+0i$（虛部為 $0$），確實是實數 ✓。
alt.en: With k equal to minus one half, a calculator in complex mode gives minus 0.5 with zero imaginary part, confirming that the number is real.

eph-en02-m1.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q30 · EPH WS05 Q30 · [HKDSE 2023 Paper 2 Q34]

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 第一項：分子分母同乘 $k+2i$
title.en: Step 1 · First term: multiply by k + 2i

steps.en: The denominator becomes k squared plus 4, because minus i squared is plus 1. The numerator is k i minus 2.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 第二項：分子分母同乘 $k-2i$
title.en: Step 2 · Second term: multiply by k - 2i

steps.zh: 分母同樣是 $k^{2}+4$（兩項的分母相同，之後可以直接相減）；分子 $2(k-2i)=2k-4i$。
steps.en: The denominator is the same k squared plus 4, so the two fractions can be subtracted directly; the numerator is 2k - 4i.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 相減並讀出虛部
title.en: Step 3 · Subtract and read off the imaginary part

steps.zh: 實部 $-2-2k$、虛部 $k+4$，所以虛部是 $\frac{k+4}{k^{2}+4}$，答案 B。
steps.en: The real part is minus 2 minus 2k and the imaginary part is k + 4, so the answer is option B.

traps.en: The denominator is written as k squared minus 4, but minus 4 i squared is plus 4.

traps.zh: $2k-2$ 是相減時沒有把第二項整個減去：應是 $(-2)-(2k)=-2-2k$。
traps.en: The whole second numerator must be subtracted, giving minus 2 minus 2k.

traps.zh: 分母對，但分子符號錯：$-2-2k$ 寫成了 $2k+2$，虛部跟着錯。
traps.en: The denominator is right but the real part is written with the opposite sign.

tip.zh: 分母有 $i$ 的加減題：每一項各自乘共軛（分母都是 $a^{2}+b^{2}$），合併時實部、虛部分開整理，最後才讀虛部。
tip.en: For sums of fractions with i below: multiply each term by its conjugate so both denominators become a squared plus b squared, then combine the real and imaginary parts separately.

name.zh: 驗算法：代一個具體的 $k$ 核對
name.en: Check: substitute a value for k

alt.en: Substituting k = 0 gives an imaginary part of 1 and several options agree, so test a second value such as k = 3 to single out the correct expression.

eph-en02-m2.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q31 · EPH WS05 Q31 · [HKDSE 2013 Paper 2 Q36]

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 化簡每個 $i$ 的冪（除以 4 看餘數）
title.en: Step 1 · Reduce every power of i using the remainder

steps.en: The remainders of 18, 19, 20 and 21 on division by 4 give minus 1, minus i, 1 and i respectively.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 代入並合併同類項
title.en: Step 2 · Substitute and collect like terms

steps.en: The real parts give minus 6 and the imaginary parts give minus 7 i, so the value is minus 6 minus 7 i.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 讀出實部
title.en: Step 3 · Read off the real part

steps.zh: 題目問 real part：$-6$，答案 B。（$-7$ 是這個數的虛部 —— 選項 A 就是為此而設的陷阱。）
steps.en: The real part is minus 6, so the answer is B; minus 7 is the imaginary part and is offered as a trap.

traps.zh: $-7$ 是化簡結果 $-6-7i$ 的虛部；題目問實部，答了虛部就中了這個陷阱。
traps.en: Minus 7 is the imaginary part of the simplified value; the question asks for the real part.
This comes from remembering i to the fourth as minus 1, so that i to the twentieth is also treated as minus 1.
Six appears when both real contributions have their signs reversed.

tip.zh: $i$ 的冪：除以 4 看餘數。化簡成 $a+bi$ 之後看清楚題目問實部還是虛部 —— 兩個答案通常同時出現在選項裡。
tip.en: Reduce powers of i by their remainder on division by 4, then check whether the question wants the real or the imaginary part; both usually appear among the options.

name.zh: 驗算法：先看 $i$ 的週期，再核對總和
name.en: Check: use the period of i and verify the total

alt.en: Since powers of i repeat with period 4, the expression can be rewritten with exponents 2, 3, 4 and 1, which again gives minus 6 minus 7 i.

eph-en02-m3.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q32 · EPH WS05 Q32 · [HKDSE 2018 Paper 2 Q37]

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 化簡分子的每個 $i$ 的冪
title.en: Step 1 · Reduce every power of i in the numerator

steps.en: The remainders 1, 2, 3, 0 and 1 give i, minus 1, minus i, 1 and i in turn.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 合併分子
title.en: Step 2 · Combine the numerator

steps.en: The real parts give minus 16 and the imaginary parts give minus 2, so the numerator is minus 16 minus 2 i.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 除以 $1-i$：分子分母同乘共軛
title.en: Step 3 · Divide by 1 - i using its conjugate

steps.en: The denominator becomes 2, and the numerator is multiplied by 1 + i.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 化簡並讀出虛部
title.en: Step 4 · Simplify and read off the imaginary part

steps.en: Expanding gives minus 14 minus 18 i, which reduces to minus 7 minus 9 i, so the imaginary part is minus 9.

traps.zh: $-7$ 是 $-7-9i$ 的實部；題目問虛部，答了實部就錯了。
traps.en: Minus 7 is the real part of the final value, but the question asks for the imaginary part.
The imaginary part keeps its minus sign after the division.

traps.zh: $7$ 是把實部的符號也當成虛部（同一類符號錯，把 $-7-9i$ 看成 $7+9i$ 再讀虛部）。
traps.en: Seven arises from flipping both signs of the final value before reading the imaginary part.

tip.zh: 先化簡分子的每個 $i$ 的冪，合併成 $a+bi$，最後才做除法（乘共軛）。次序清楚就不會亂。
tip.en: Reduce every power of i first, combine them into a single complex number, and only then divide by multiplying by the conjugate.

name.zh: 驗算法：把 $1-i$ 的倒數記成 $\frac{1+i}{2}$
name.en: Check: remember that one over 1 - i is (1 + i) over 2

alt.en: Writing the reciprocal of 1 - i as (1 + i) over 2 turns the division into a multiplication, which gives the same result minus 7 minus 9 i.

eph-en02-m4.source: Endeavour Lesson 2 Q33 · EPH WS05 Q33 · [HKDSE 2019 Paper 2 Q34]

title.en: Step 1 · Reduce i to the 13th and i to the 18th

steps.en: The first remainder gives i and the second gives minus 1, so minus i to the 18th becomes plus 1, which must not be dropped.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 分子分母同乘 $a+i$
title.en: Step 2 · Multiply top and bottom by a + i

steps.en: The denominator becomes a squared plus 1, and expanding the numerator gives 8a + 1 plus (8 - a) times i.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 加上那個 $1$，讀出實部
title.en: Step 3 · Add the plus 1 and read off the real part

steps.en: Writing the integer 1 over the same denominator lets the numerators be added, giving a real part of a squared plus 8a plus 2 over a squared plus 1.

traps.zh: $\frac{8a+1}{a^{2}+1}$ 是漏了 $-i^{18}=+1$ 那一項：只做完除法就選答案。
traps.en: This omits the plus 1 that comes from minus i to the 18th.
This drops the plus 1 and also uses a squared minus 1 as the denominator.
The numerator is right here but the denominator has the wrong sign.

tip.zh: 先化簡 $i$ 的冪（$-i^{18}=+1$ 也要寫出來），再做除法；把整數寫成分數（分子分母同乘 $a^{2}+1$）就不會漏掉那一項。
tip.en: Reduce the powers of i first, then divide; writing the integer as a fraction over the same denominator makes sure it is not forgotten.

name.zh: 驗算法：代 $a=0$ 快速核對
name.en: Check: put a equal to zero

alt.en: Putting a equal to zero gives a real part of 2, which matches option D and rules out the others.

eph-en02-m5.source: Lesson 2 課後針對練習（自編）· 判別式：無實根 → 求 k 的範圍

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 無實根 ⇒ $\Delta<0$
title.en: Step 1 · No real roots means a negative discriminant

steps.en: No real roots means the discriminant is strictly negative; with a = 1, b = 4 and c = k it becomes 16 - 4k.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 解不等式，寫成範圍
title.en: Step 2 · Solve the inequality and state the range

steps.zh: 把 $-4k$ 搬去右邊得 $16<4k$，兩邊同除 $4$（正數，不等號不變）得 $k>4$，答案 B。
steps.en: Moving the negative term across gives 16 is less than 4k, so k is greater than 4 and the answer is B.

traps.zh: $k<4$ 是不等號方向反了：把 $16-4k<0$ 兩邊同除 $-4$ 而沒有反號就會得這個答案。
traps.en: This is the result of dividing by a negative number without reversing the inequality.

traps.zh: $k\le 4$ 是把「無實根」當成「有實根」：有實根是 $\Delta\ge 0$，即 $k\le 4$。
traps.en: This treats the question as having real roots, where the discriminant is at least zero.

traps.zh: $k\ge 4$ 是同一種混淆再加上方向錯。
traps.en: This combines the wrong condition with the wrong direction.

tip.zh: 「無實根」$\Delta<0$、「有實根」$\Delta\ge 0$，兩者剛好相反；解不等式時把負項搬去另一邊就不會反號。
tip.en: No real roots needs a negative discriminant while real roots allow the equality; move negative terms across instead of dividing by them.

name.zh: 驗算法：範圍內外各取一個數核對
name.en: Check: test one value inside and one outside

alt.en: With k = 5 the discriminant is negative, and with k = 3 it is positive, so the boundary at 4 is confirmed.

eph-en02-m6.source: Lesson 2 課後針對練習（自編）· 複數：展開後讀虛部（分清實部與虛部）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 展開，四項都要寫
title.en: Step 1 · Expand: all four products must appear

steps.zh: 逐項相乘：$3\times1=3$、$3\times i=3i$、$-2i\times1=-2i$、$-2i\times i=-2i^{2}$。
steps.en: Multiply term by term: 3, 3i, minus 2i and minus 2 i squared.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用 $i^{2}=-1$ 化簡成 $a+bi$
title.en: Step 2 · Use i squared equal to minus one

steps.en: Minus 2 i squared becomes plus 2, so the value is 5 + i with real part 5 and imaginary part 1.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 讀出虛部
title.en: Step 3 · Read off the imaginary part

steps.zh: 虛部是 $i$ 前面的數：$1$，答案 B。$5$ 是實部（選項 C 就是這個陷阱）。
steps.en: The imaginary part is the number in front of i, which is 1, so the answer is B; 5 is the real part.

traps.zh: $5$ 是實部；題目問 imaginary part（虛部）。
traps.en: Five is the real part, but the question asks for the imaginary part.

traps.zh: $5+i$ 是整個複數：虛部是一個實數（$i$ 的係數），不是一整塊 $5+i$。
traps.en: The imaginary part is a single real number, not the whole complex number.

traps.zh: $3$ 是漏了 $-2i\times1=-2i$ 那一項：虛部只餘 $3i$。展開時四項都要寫。
traps.en: Three comes from missing the term minus 2i, so only 3i is left before simplification.

tip.zh: 展開 → 用 $i^{2}=-1$ 化簡 → 寫成 $a+bi$，最後才讀虛部；題目問實部還是虛部要看清。
tip.en: Expand, replace i squared by minus 1, tidy into a + bi, and only then read the part that is asked for.

name.zh: 驗算法：逐項核對四個積
name.en: Check: verify the four products one by one

alt.en: Checking the four products gives 3, 3i, minus 2i and plus 2, so the value is 5 + i with imaginary part 1.
